crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’ ”
Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’ ”
Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel…
He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested…
The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!
Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very…
The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For…
Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

people.name: Massah
people.line: A place where the Israelites tested God

translations.web: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
translations.bsb: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
translations.asv: Ye shall not tempt Jehovah your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
